snippet.title: Lebih ringan dari atlet parkour sungguhan?

Hal ini karena mereka memiliki ajaran yang disebut Qinggong, yaitu teknik meringankan tubuh yang terus dilatih untuk meningkatkan kekuatan kaki, keseimbangan dan kelincahan saat bergerak.
Itulah kenapa saat mereka melompat, tubuh mereka terlihat sangat ringan, seolah bisa berputar dan bergerak bebas di udara tanpa kesulitan sedikit pun.

snippet.title: 日本が「炭素繊維」を超えた！世界を変える新発明の正体
snippet.description:
日本が開発した「炭素繊維」が、長年使われてきた従来の素材の常識を変えようとしています。

鋼鉄よりも軽く、非常に高い強度を持つ炭素繊維。さらに、日本では航空機や自動車、次世代の産業分野への応用が進められています。

この技術がさらに普及すれば、電気自動車、ロボット、航空機、ドローン、さまざまな分野で大きな変化が起きる可能性があります。

なぜ日本は「未来を変える素材」として炭素繊維に力を入れているのでしょうか？
そして、炭素繊維は本当に従来の素材を超えられるのでしょうか？

この動画では、その仕組みと日本が誇る炭素繊維技術、そして世界各国の最新研究まで、分かりやすく解説します。

snippet.description:

Alef Aeronautics की ओर से जारी वीडियो में उसकी फ्लाइंग कार को कैलिफोर्निया के सैन मेटियो में कई Tesla कारों के ऊपर उड़ते हुए दिखाया गया है। इनमें Tesla Roadster भी शामिल है।

Alef के CEO Jim Dukhovny ने कहा, “फ्लाइंग कार की रेस में Tesla का स्वागत है। हम पिछले 11 साल से इस क्षेत्र में अकेले काम कर रहे हैं। प्रतियोगिता होना अच्छी बात है, खासकर जब सामने Tesla जैसी बड़ी कंपनी हो।”
कंपनी के मुताबिक, यह वीडियो Tesla के फ्लाइंग Roadster के डेमो के साथ जारी किया गया। साथ ही, इसे Alef कार की 1,000वीं उड़ान पूरी होने के मौके पर भी जारी किया गया।

Alef ने बताया कि उसकी कार Vertical Takeoff यानी सीधे ऊपर उड़ान भरने के लिए Distributed Electric Propulsion (DEP) तकनीक का इस्तेमाल करती है। वहीं, Tesla Roadster में thrusters का इस्तेमाल किए जाने की योजना है।

snippet.description:
২৪ বছরে ১১৩ মেয়ের বিয়ে! অসহায় মেয়েদের পাশে রুবেল | Star News


For 24 years, Ruhul Amin Rubel has been helping underprivileged girls get married, taking responsibility for the wedding expenses of families who cannot afford them. His latest act of kindness brought happiness to a struggling family in Naogaon, Bangladesh.

Rubel arranged the wedding of 20-year-old Afsana Mim, daughter of van driver Afchhar Ali, treating her like his own daughter. From the Gaye Holud ceremony to the wedding arrangements, he took responsibility for making her special day memorable. Mim married Kawsar Mondal, son of Sabuj Mondal, on October 9.

The newlyweds, their families, and local residents expressed their gratitude and prayers for Rubel's humanitarian initiative. According to Rubel, he undertakes these efforts to seek the pleasure of Allah and is willing to travel anywhere in Bangladesh to help genuinely underprivileged families.

Watch this inspiring story of humanity, kindness, and a helping hand that turns a family's worries into happiness.

snippet.title: [날씨] 내일(18일), 요란한 가을비…시간당 최대 30mm 호우 / KBS 2026.10.17.
snippet.description:
가을 나들이에 무리 없는 하루였습니다.

 맑고 포근한 날씨가 이어졌는데요.

 내일은 요란한 가을비가 내리며 날씨가 확 달라지겠습니다.

 오전에 중부지방을 시작으로 오후에는 전국으로 비가 확대되겠고, 시간당 최대 30mm의 집중호우가 쏟아질 가능성도 있습니다.

 비의 양은 수도권과 충청, 전북에 최대 80mm, 강원 내륙과 전남광주에 20~70mm로 가을비치곤 많겠습니다.

 내일 아침 기온은 서울과 전주가 17도, 부산 19도로 출발하겠습니다.

 한낮엔 서울이 21도로 오늘보다 5도가량 낮겠습니다.

 남부지방에선 광주가 26도, 대구는 25도까지 오르겠습니다.

 바다의 물결은 서해와 동해상에서 최고 5m로 매우 높게 일겠습니다.

 남부지방과 제주도는 다음 주 중반까지 비가 자주 내리겠습니다.

 날씨 전해드렸습니다.

snippet.title: What's happening to the Black Church? | Full Episode
snippet.description:
A shift is emerging within the Black church. As nondenominational churches like Philip Anthony Mitchell's 2819 grow and voting patterns change, some pastors are questioning the role race and politics should play in church life. Others are finding new political alignment with President Trump and the Republican Party.

For generations, Black churches have helped organize communities, build political movements and shape American history. From the Civil Rights Movement to modern elections, they have been among the most influential institutions in Black America. So what happens when that relationship between faith and politics starts to change?

In this episode of "Curiosities of the South," AJC and UATL producer Najja Parker returns to the world she grew up in to find answers. Her journey takes her from one of Atlanta's fastest-growing megachurches to Ebenezer Baptist Church, home of Martin Luther King Jr.'s ministry, as she explores the competing ideas reshaping the Black church today.

Along the way, she examines questions about race, identity, political influence and faith, and asks what these changes could mean for the future of the Black church and its role in American politics as voters head into the 2026 midterm elections.
